value.summary: Phase-2 task detail for ph-7102 — JIT-expanded at the phase boundary.

sections.name: summary
sections.value:
Task detail for ph-7102. Each task row carries one done link to its own done_when list; every assertion names its instrument via a pressure link (or an explicit not-applicable with the real instrument in its note). Task state is computed from that list, never typed.

Hand-authored at the phase-2 boundary — still the JIT dogfood: this file is the shape tk-7142's 5-tasks verb must reproduce mechanically, and its dw- ids were minted by dd add --mint (never hand-rolled). Born under the 071 corpus; all ids are 71xx by prime's ordinal ruling.

value.title: Refusal evidence: envelope.error.code into command_exit + SessionEvidence/resolvers widening (lock-step)
value.success: A refused nav set lands in telemetry as command_exit with the gate E-code (fixed vocab, no free text); SessionEvidence exposes it and the flow-eval resolvers mirror stays lock-step (CLI test green); the flow file remains untouched on refusal (invariant pin unchanged).
value.notes: Research: refusal-evidence triple loss; force already durable via dd-gate-override

tk-7131.assertion: DdLink check variant parses and validates; a hand-edited or malformed check link is refused or dropped per the F004/F007 sanitize discipline (planted-bad fires).
Untrusted-reading rules pinned by test: gate evaluation never executes or trusts document-supplied text.

tk-7132.assertion: A non-green check gate refuses departure quoting the validator findings verbatim; nothing is written on refusal.
--force departs and records a defended override exactly as the completion gate does.

tk-7133.assertion: A fresh flow from the template carries per-phase gates plus the last-review check gate, authored with bare-ordinal addresses.
Pre-JIT departure (target document not yet born) refuses target-invalid rather than passing vacuously.

tk-7134.assertion: Dep-cruiser rule + seam test refuse a module-path reach past the barrel (planted-bad import fires).
tk-7134.note: instrument is the arch gate itself (dep-cruiser + seam test), not a backpressure row

tk-7135.assertion: Check-gate badge and rail callout render when a gate exists; absence renders byte-identical with no legend entry.
tk-7135.note: instrument is the flow render golden suite, not a backpressure row

tk-7141.assertion: 1b plan authors plan.dd.json with built sibling; a fresh plan validates 0/0 and renders; no -plan.md is emitted.
The dd-native root allow-list is stated and holds; the flow discovers the dd plan.

tk-7142.assertion: The 5-tasks verb births a valid done_when-shaped task file with minted ids AND lands the phase-row tasks link in the same change.

tk-7143.assertion: Stage 6/6a state flips go through the dd verbs, visible in source and rebuilt sibling; no hand-edited generated md.

tk-7144.assertion: orient at each node prints that node's dd commands from baked instructions[] (template and expander).

tk-7145.assertion: Stage modules teach their seam's dd commands; the dry-run reader gap check passes.

tk-7146.assertion: A legacy markdown plan folder fixture still detects, adopts, and resumes (detection test green).

tk-7147.assertion: Scripted joint-exit dry-run with the CLI as actor: create, JIT, refuse (findings quoted), green, depart — exercising the refusal through real artifacts.

tk-7169.assertion: A refused nav set lands in telemetry as command_exit carrying the gate E-code (fixed vocabulary, no free text); the flow file is untouched on refusal.
SessionEvidence exposes the refusal and the flow-eval resolvers mirror stays lock-step (CLI test green).
